raw.rationale: Canertinib is an irreversible pan-ERBB inhibitor whose antiproliferative/cytotoxic effects at 2.5 µM for 5 days are most likely in ERBB-driven lineages, especially EGFR/ERBB2-addicted lung and breast cancers and ERBB2-amplified breast/gastric models, while most other lineages lack strong ERBB dependency and would show little selective killing. Published PRISM-type screens generally show few lineage-selective hits, so probabilities are kept low except for lung and breast where ERBB alterations are enriched.
